title: Insurance Claim Services Manual: Recording Carrier Decisions and Scope Approvals
content:
**Section.** The carrier's decision on the submitted estimate is recorded exactly as the carrier's approval letter states it: an approval moves the file to approved and records the initial scope approval by coverage part, and a denial moves it to denied, after which nothing is billed under the file and every job of the loss becomes the customer's own responsibility. The claim file must be in approved status when a scope approval is recorded. A supplement approval names the supplement request it decides and records the amount the carrier approved, which may be less than requested; the approved amount raises the carrier receivable and the depreciation the carrier withholds is recorded on the same line. An estimate at or above the tier's initial reinspection threshold, or a supplement at or above the supplement reinspection threshold, is approved only after the carrier's reinspection.

This section of the Insurance Claim Services manual covers the carrier's approval, its denial and every scope approval line. The reinspection thresholds are each tier's own figures.

## Effects of each decision

| Carrier decision | File status after | What is recorded |
|---|---|---|
| approval of the estimate | approved | the initial scope approval, by coverage part |
| denial of coverage | denied | nothing is billed under the file afterwards; every job of the loss becomes the customer's own responsibility |
| supplement approval | stays approved | the amount approved (possibly less than requested), naming the supplement it decides, with the depreciation withheld on the same line |

- A scope approval is recorded only while the file's status on the system record is approved.
- Each approved amount raises the carrier receivable.

## Reinspection boundary (hypothetical tier with a 25000.00 initial threshold and a 5000.00 supplement threshold)

| Amount | Approved only after reinspection? |
|---|---|
| estimate of 25000.00 | yes |
| estimate of 24999.99 | no |
| supplement of 5000.00 | yes |
| supplement of 4999.99 | no |
